en: Monochrome printed art postcard showing a dramatic, symbolist-style scene beside a rocky shoreline. A woman in a headscarf kneels on a pebbled ground holding the body of a nude or nearly nude man who lies stretched out on a cloth, as if dead or unconscious. Skulls and bones are scattered in the foreground, and large rocks line the dark water behind them. Above the woman's head a pattern of parallel white lines appears in the sky or water. The overall mood is somber and mythic. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
